title: Chess: en passant capture
description: When a pawn advances 2 squares from its starting rank, the opponent can capture it en passant on the next turn only. Track last_double_push (col, row) per turn. En passant: pawn captures diagonally to the square the opponent pawn passed through, removing the opponent pawn from its actual position.
close_reason: En passant capture with one-turn window, target tracking, captured pawn removal. 5 tests.
